comment: Pinned portable tools for the acceptance rewrap (issue #55). Every download is sha256-verified before it is unpacked. Each run works from a private and verified snapshot: the whole 7-Zip folder and the whole NSIS tree are copied into a fresh per-run directory, the COPY is hashed against the pins below, and the tools are launched from that copy. Private and verified is not immutable; the exact residual (a writer to the harness root who races a run with change-and-restore, and compile-time side effects of a hostile include) is an accident-control limit. See tools/release/nsis/PROVENANCE.md for what each checksumSource means (no upstream-signed checksum is claimed anywhere).

bootstrap.checksumSource: GitHub release-asset digest (sha256) reported by the GitHub API for ip7z/7zip tag 26.03; not a publisher-signed checksum

extra.checksumSource: GitHub release-asset digest (sha256) reported by the GitHub API for ip7z/7zip tag 26.03; not a publisher-signed checksum

msi.checksumSource: GitHub release-asset digest (sha256) reported by the GitHub API for ip7z/7zip tag 26.03; not a publisher-signed checksum. The MSI is only UNPACKED with 7za.exe (never executed or installed).

sevenZip.treeNote: tree hash (same algorithm as nsis.treeSha256) of the whole unpacked 7-Zip folder: 7zr.exe, 7za.exe, 7z.exe, 7z.dll. Recorded from the first unpack (trust-on-first-use of the unpack step); any extra file (Codecs, Formats, a planted dll) changes it.
sevenZip.binariesNote: 7z.exe and 7z.dll are _7z.exe and _7z.dll from the MSI, renamed. Their hashes were recorded from the first unpack (trust-on-first-use of the unpack step; the MSI itself is pinned above).

download.checksumSource: SourceForge files listing for NSIS 3/3.11 reports sha256 c7d27f78...94fa1 (and sha1 ef7ff767...b10d, which equals the NSIS_SHA1 pinned by tauri-bundler 2.9.3 for the same file); SourceForge-hosted metadata, not a publisher-signed checksum

nsis.makensisNote: sha256 of Bin/makensis.exe inside the pinned tree (recorded from the same first unpack; it is also covered by treeSha256)
nsis.treeNote: treeSha256 = sha256 over sorted lines '<lowercase relative path>:<file sha256>' (LF-terminated) of the unpacked tree with the leading nsis-3.11/ stripped; recorded from the first unpack (trust-on-first-use of the unpack step; the zip itself is pinned above)

tauriUtilsDll.source: extracted from the released v1.2.0 installer ($PLUGINSDIR); this is the only installer-machinery file kept, as a compile-time plugin input
